Collision |ranged_damage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]170 |ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]2 |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]35 |speed = 3.5 |hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} |flying = {{Attr|Flying|Yes}} }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Aims her sniper rifle before firing a powerful shot; no witnesses.|In-Game Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Contractor''', internally referred to as '''KingpinHitman''', is a unit spawned by the [[Kingpin]] at Level 6B. Like most other units, it starts from one of the entrances of the map and moves towards the exit. Whenever there is an enemy in its range, it will stop moving to attack it. It will continue walking if there are no enemies in its range for a few seconds. ==Appearance== The '''Contractor''' has pale skin and black hair with a white stripe. Purple shirt and pants, brown jacket and shoes. Wields a VSS Vintorez sniper rifle to attack enemies. ==Strategy== *The '''Contractor''' has the highest range and DPS out of all offensive units, making it a very effective option against enemies. However, it does have the lowest health and highest spawn time in comparison to other units. *While the [[Kingpin]] does not have hidden detection, the '''Contractor''' does, meaning it can be used to deal with [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies. **It can also be used to help out with [[Flying]] and [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies, as it has all three detections. ==Other== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} KingpinThumbnail.png|'''Contractor''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} KingpinBoomerangUpdateIcon.png|'''Contractor''' on the game icon. }} ==Update History== *'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]] **'''Contractor''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Contractor''' deals no damage to [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies. *'''7 August 2026''' - [[v2.5.0]] **{{Bugfix}} '''Contractor''' now deals damage to [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies. *'''14 August 2026''' - [[v2.6.0]] **Health increased from 200 to 400. **Damage increased from 165 to 170. **Lifespan increased from 70 to 75. {{TowerNavBox}}
